requiredFindings.title: Fence every disclosed or derived page dependency, including unreturned lookahead and copied cursor keys
requiredFindings.finding: The before-paging predicate and returned-row output checks are strong, but the proposal does not explicitly define the complete output dependency set. has_more depends on an unreturned lookahead row, and each unencrypted descendant cursor copies ceiling keys from the first page. Current session/action/query-scope binding and checks of returned rows do not necessarily revalidate those source-object/purpose/retention dependencies. Being permitted on an originating page plus a600-second cursor window is not by itself current permission to re-emit linkable record keys.
concreteScenarios: With limit1, rowA is returned and rowB is the sole eligible lookahead. B loses object/consent authority after query and before output. If only A participates in the output fence, has_more:true reveals that now-denied work exists, despite the explicit no-denied-row-through-has_more rule.

A first page fixes ceilingA. Later A expires or its object/purpose access is revoked while session/query policy remains otherwise valid. A subsequent page returns other allowed rows and re-emits unencrypted ceilingA UUID/timestamp in next_cursor unless anchor copy eligibility is separately checked; the historical allowance can outlive source-copy authority.
requiredFindings.requiredChange: Define participating dependencies explicitly: returned rows, lookahead rows used for has_more and every source-derived ceiling/after key emitted or used to authorize a new bookmark. Before output, current authoritative object/purpose/consent/assignment and copy-expiry fences must cover relevant dependencies. A lost/unknown dependency must not produce partial/shortened success or an authorization-independent has_more; use truthful generic restart/denial/unavailable as appropriate. Bound cursor/private metadata retention to its applicable source or separately reviewed necessary purpose;600seconds is a maximum navigation window, not a new copy-retention grant. If a different historical-key purpose is intended, specify and review that binding rather than inheriting the original row grant silently.
requiredFindings.scopeLimit: Do not reinterpret this as a frozen multi-page snapshot or require detecting every concurrent insert. It addresses disclosure dependencies already used by this page/cursor; live membership and late-commit limitations remain.
futureOracles: Revoke/expire only the unreturned lookahead between observation/output: no denied existence bit or fresh cursor leak.
Revoke/expire an old ceiling/after source while other rows stay allowed: no reissued forbidden key metadata or life extension.
Unknown dependency/fence/source state cannot become empty page, guessed has_more or partial success; preserve non-disclosing outcomes.
requiredFindings.boundary: Local logical correction within existing deny-by-default/output/copy rules; no new founder role or new endpoint choice is required. Actual shared fences, queries and cursor encoding remain later independently reviewed implementation work.

reviewedAssessments.subject: Existing routes, membership and grants
reviewedAssessments.assessment: Exactly IF-STAFF-10 handoffs,16 alert exceptions and18 booking exceptions. Query filters narrow current scope and do not assign work. Current session/action/object/purpose rules deny unknown grants; four content roles/admin are not an operational inheritance ladder. Handoff requested/queued vocabulary matches lifecycle62-64. Current queue-visibility/assignment policy is explicitly held and does not grant all unassigned records.

reviewedAssessments.subject: Minimal projections and source classification
reviewedAssessments.assessment: Items carry only bounded IDs/current revision/immutable server creation metadata, canonical wing or family and closed read classifications. No transcript/content/contact/provider payload, role/consent history, secret or action grant. Alert OUTCOME_UNKNOWN/ACTION_REQUIRED are explicitly derived read classes, not stored lifecycle states or parent confirmation. Booking classes correspond to existing exception purposes; unknown mappings are unavailable. recorded_at and exact class mappings are proposed metadata prerequisites, not assertions that current source stores already contain them.

reviewedAssessments.subject: No parent mutation or staff-session renewal
reviewedAssessments.assessment: Reads do not mark seen, self-assign/accept/decline/end, verify email, dispatch/reconcile external effects or confirm/cancel parent work. Detail and mutations retain current authorization/revision/lifecycle checks. No staff idle/absolute renewal from list activity; this agrees with existing session474-489. Future auth-transport rotation cannot redefine list activity.

reviewedAssessments.subject: First and continuation query grammar
reviewedAssessments.assessment: Closed first-page limit plus one allowlisted filter, canonical1..25/default25 and cursor-only continuation prevent caller sort/offset/tenant/free-text/query widening. Raw duplicates/aliases/percent-plus/brackets/unknowns are expressly rejected. This requires future trusted raw-target parsing across ingress/HTTP versions, not a permissive parsed dictionary assumption.

reviewedAssessments.subject: Live keyset semantics and honest has_more
reviewedAssessments.assessment: Descending unique immutable(recorded_at,item_id), first-page ceiling and strict after boundary avoid offset/commit-order claims. Each page is a current scoped observation; late commits/membership/deletion can affect later pages, and refresh is needed for current head. LIMIT+1 complete eligible observation, has_more/next_cursor correlation and no total/denied count are coherent. OPREAD01 must make output dependencies explicit; no all-work/export completeness follows.

reviewedAssessments.subject: Cursor confidentiality, integrity and lifetime
reviewedAssessments.assessment: Cursor explicitly is not encrypted or bearer authority. Payload excludes actor/session/grant/content/secrets; trusted route/session/principal/scope binding stays outside payload. Domain separation/length delimiting/full HMAC-SHA256 constant-time comparison/canonical unpadded encoding and bounded payload/token length are plausible candidates, not selected or implemented cryptography. Original600second chain window is nonrenewing; rotation may invalidate bookmarks. Source-derived key purpose/expiry needs OPREAD01; MAC validity cannot supply permission. Unknown key/time/fence handling needs exact wire categorization without unsafe fallback.

reviewedAssessments.subject: HTTP and refusal behavior
reviewedAssessments.assessment: Same-origin cookie/Origin/Fetch Metadata controls preserve existing staff authentication/action boundaries;403 is uniform and introduces no new challenge or redirect. Fixed400/403/409/429/503/500 projections and object-independent bodyless405/501/406/414/431/HEAD are distinguished. 429 here is a proposed bounded fixed error body, not an automatic copy of visitor-booking bodyless429. No requirement from those separate routes is silently imported. Exact status/body/media/raw/error mappings remain next wire work.

reviewedAssessments.subject: Finite three-route work
reviewedAssessments.assessment: One proposed32reader service pool, one active reader per eligible staff session,60starts/60seconds across routes/tabs/JWT rotations/workers,1024authorized-key cap, no queue/active eviction and reservations through settlement. Header/target/framing/2second projection/5second delivery/10second client and32768success/1024error limits are explicitly unmeasured. No hidden per-route pool, server-wide tab coordination claim or accepted capacity/SLA. Physical query/limiter/cancellation/cleanup and load remain held.
